reason: I've never heard of Nora Furnish and there are no reviews, Trustpilot score or track record on the page, and I don't wire my kitchen with a light from a store I can't verify. Nothing says UL listed either, and my electrician won't hang something that isn't.
objection: Is it UL listed and safe, and will my electrician install it? I also can't find out if this store is legit, and with return shipping on me for a change of mind I'd be stuck with a 24-inch pendant if it shows up wrong.
would_change_my_mind: Visible UL/ETL listing on the product page, plus a solid pile of independent reviews (Trustpilot or similar) from real buyers with photos, and a clear delivery date that lands before my electrician's visit.
